attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"This suggests a temporary truce, which is always a fragile thing.","severity":"minor","reason":"Implies prior conflict and fragility; the briefing reports only a peace feast."},{"span":"continues to offer prizes for new inventions","severity":"minor","reason":"States that old news is ongoing; the briefing does not say the prizes are still on offer."},{"span":"The Mire Rats remain a nuisance","severity":"minor","reason":"Adds an ongoing threat the briefing does not report."}],"voice":3,"clarity":4,"tone":3,"overall":3,"comment":"With only one new item, it pads the bulletin with two items of old news, recycled as if still developing.
